name: Clag
summary: A multi-phase trick-taking bidding game where players predict tricks, with special misere and blind rounds, highest total wins.
rules_text: Clag is played with a 52-card deck, Aces high, 3-7 players. The game has 20-22 deals in three phases. Phase 1 deals 1 to 7 cards increasing. Phase 2 deals 7 cards with special rules per deal: No Trumps, Guess trumps after bidding, Misere where tricks deduct, Blind where you bid before seeing hand, Roll Em playing cards blind in order, Twos Wild, Aces Low etc. Phase 3 reverses Phase 1 from 7 down to 1. Each deal: dealer shuffles, deals required cards, flips top of stock for trump if applicable. In clockwise order from eldest hand players nominate tricks to win; dealer last and total nominations may not equal number of cards dealt. Trick play: must follow suit if able; highest trump wins else highest of led suit. Winner leads next. Scoring: exact bid scores 10 plus 2 per trick taken, otherwise 0. In misere variants, penalty per trick and 10 for zero. Highest cumulative score after final deal wins.
rating_reason: Oh Hell-like trick-taking, 3-7 players, specific bidding.
